name: Jens Gieseke, Paulius Saudargas - Article 6, § 1, après l'alinéa 2 - Am 394
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles, amending Regulations (EU) 2018/858 and 2019/1020 and repealing Directives 2000/53/EC and 2005/64/EC
part_text: Member States may temporarily suspend the application of the obligations set out in Article 6(1) where the availability or price levels of secondary raw materials reach levels liable to undermine the competitiveness of their automotive industry.
